title: AI下一阶段：亚洲工程与研究结合，比博士更实用？
speaker: Gareth Nicholson

segments.en: Let's see, when we're looking at different parts of the market, as you said, AI now has been for the last while, focusing on who's the next AI PhD, the smartest AI that's available there.
segments.zh: 让我们看看，当我们观察市场的不同部分时，正如你所说，AI最近一段时间一直专注于谁拥有下一个AI博士，那里最聪明的AI。

segments.en: But when we think of actual production and where the next phase could be, we maybe don't need a PhD for a robot development clean window that's going up and down the old age.
segments.zh: 但当我们考虑实际生产和下一阶段可能在哪里时，我们可能不需要博士来开发一个在旧时代上下移动的机器人清洁窗户。

segments.en: We maybe don't need a PhD level for some of the manufacturing. We need a specialist role in a certain sector. And if we can do that efficiency, then I think we'll see AI being involved in a lot more robotics,
segments.zh: 我们可能不需要博士水平来进行一些制造。我们需要在某个领域有专家角色。如果我们能做到这种效率，那么我认为我们将看到AI参与更多的机器人技术，

segments.en: a lot more manufacturing. So I think as we broaden the uses of AI, we need less of the highest PhD possible, and more being able to integrate into many different fields,
segments.zh: 更多的制造业。所以我认为随着我们拓宽AI的用途，我们需要更少的最高的博士，而更多能够整合到许多不同领域，

segments.en: where we need specialists instead of this huge height. I mean, the PhD level is going to open up new doors, but I think the availability is where we're going to see a lot.
segments.zh: 我们需要专家而不是这个巨大的高度。我的意思是，博士水平将打开新的大门，但我认为可用性是我们将看到很多的地方。

segments.en: And this is where we see the combination of particularly in Asia, where you've got AI engineering with AR research coming together, more practically, more options, and more opportunities for investors.
segments.zh: 这就是我们看到特别是在亚洲的结合，那里你有AI工程与AR研究结合在一起，更实际，更多选择，以及为配置者带来更多机会。
